claims.text: Dietary patterns are associated with cancer, coronary heart disease, stroke, and type 2 diabetes.

evidence.description: The authors discuss current knowledge on the associations between dietary patterns and cancer, coronary heart disease, stroke, and type 2 diabetes.

methodologies.name: Literature Review and Synthesis
methodologies.description: Review and discussion of current knowledge, areas of uncertainty, and future research directions regarding dietary patterns and chronic disease risk.

limitations.text: There are areas of uncertainty in current knowledge regarding the associations between dietary patterns and chronic disease prevention.

future_work.text: Address areas of uncertainty regarding food-based dietary patterns and chronic disease outcomes.
